verdict.rationale: Undermind's site says users can "trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper" (docs-12). Its workspace syntheses and reports carry citations that link back to the source papers (docs-6, docs-4). A community user says Undermind solves the problem of LLMs being reluctant to give references (comm-8), which is only loose corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how citations are attached and displayed, and independent hands-on checks that every substantive claim is cited and that the citations accurately support the statements.
